principal near term impact of ongoing iran war: global recession. bad for everyone. 

principal long term impact of ongoing iran war: end of opec, faster move away from oil & gas towards post-carbon renewables. good for everyone, especially china.

if president trump is prepared to give up on the iranian uranium stockpiles, easier to get to a deal. 

united states has already taken ballistic missiles out of the negotiation (saying it’s an issue for regional actors to resolve). and there’s no route to regime change. 

looking for an exit ramp, us strategy has shifted to limiting the war goals in the service of declaring victory.
